user.title: Fire Stick ADB
user.description: Connect to the Fire Stick (same options as the Android TV integration). Magisk FtvIr must already be installed (`./ftvir setup`).

data.adbkey: Path to adbkey (optional; auto-generated if empty)

remote.title: Amazon remote
remote.description: Pick the bonded Voice Remote that has an IR LED.

brand.title: TV brand
brand.description: {hint}. Search by name or enter a brand id from Equipment Control.

profile.title: TV profile
profile.description: Enable Test blast to fire POWER_ON/TOGGLE once, then enable Confirm to save the codeset.

power.title: Power & state
power.description: IR is never used for state. Prefer discrete POWER_ON/OFF when the profile has them; otherwise gate POWER_TOGGLE with a detector. Amazon names like “Model Group 2” are shown as Brand TV unless you set a custom name.

error.helper_missing: Magisk FtvIr helper missing or not privileged — run ./ftvir setup
error.idc_failed: Amazon IDC catalog call failed (Stick must be signed in)

abort.already_configured: This Fire Stick is already configured
